In addition to releasing the public beta 2 of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is also starting to push out the first release candidate versions of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Here are the details.

Older versions of macOS continue to receive security updates

As usual with minor updates for older macOS versions, Apple has skipped the general beta stage this time and gone straight to releasing the first release candidate versions of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 at the end of last month, and both versions went through two release candidates before their official release.

The release notes Apple attached to the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only mention that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's updates included a CoreGraphics security fix with the following content:

Apple is expected to announce the details of the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 after their official release, which will very likely happen in the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

The build number of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is 24H219, while the build number of macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is 25G320.

Have you discovered any new features or differences in this release candidate? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
